dedupe_keys.name: consumption behaviour data mining with smart meter data

description: Consumption Behaviour Data Mining with Smart Meter Data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ayrton Bourn. This work uses extensive feature engineering to extract useful information about the behaviour of energy consumers. These features are then used to train a random forest model to forecast unknown monthly consumption. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
